prompt:
Our law school's Jessup Moot Court competition committee needs an automated results processor. We've collected all the raw scoring data from the group stage matches and stored it in the competition workspace. We need a Python script that processes this data and outputs a file called `tournament_results.json` containing: (1) the computed win/loss record and total points for each of the 16 teams, (2) the standings within each group, (3) the overall ranking across all groups, and (4) the first-round knockout bracket pairings.

The raw match data is in `/workspace/competition_admin/results/group_stage_raw.json`. Team and group information are in the corresponding files under `/workspace/competition_admin/participants/` and `/workspace/competition_admin/schedule/`. Please consult the competition's official SKILL.md documentation for the exact scoring rules — the Jessup competition has a very specific point system that must be followed precisely.
